evidence: Read SIGN-IN.md, the dependency audit context, DEPENDENCIES.md and the complete Postgres starter diff against origin/main. Read the sign-in module and auth route, all four migrations, user roles, shared configuration and mail, module-resolution settings, database boundary and review scripts, Dockerfile, Docker runners and hosted workflow. Sign-in behaviour and access boundaries are unchanged; no supported findings remain.

Compared every lockfile package entry with origin/main. Only hono 4.13.13 to 4.13.19 and @hono/node-server 2.1.5 to 2.1.9 change version; both are reached only through shadcn and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Direct dependency versions are unchanged. The remaining changes classify development dependencies and restore libc selectors on 28 Linux native packages without changing their versions. The application imports only shadcn/tailwind.css at build time.

npm ci passed with an isolated temporary cache: 860 packages added, 861 audited, and 23 audit findings comprising seven moderate and 16 high, matching DEPENDENCIES.md. The initial attempt could not write the default cache and is recorded below.

Ran a second isolated npm ci followed by npm prune --omit=dev. The pruned installation has 284 installed lock entries. shadcn, @shadcn/registry, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, hono and @hono/node-server are absent, including nested copies of shadcn, the SDK and Hono. npm ls --omit=dev --depth=0 exited 0. All seven runtime imports passed: better-auth, better-auth/api, better-auth/plugins, jose, pg, kysely and nodemailer. Vitest and Vite remain through the optional peer dependency path; the production installation is not free of development tooling.

Ran the requested chain through sh scripts/docker-run.sh -- node scripts/test-database.mjs. Bootstrap passed; the first migration run applied all four migrations and the repeat run passed. npm run handover:check passed; npm run test:handover passed all 136 tests with none skipped; npm run typecheck and npm run lint passed. npm test passed all 313 tests across 11 files. npm run test:files passed all 44 tests in one file against disposable Postgres and both storage emulators.

npm run build passed, including Next.js production output and worker bundling. Inspected 16 generated build trace manifests and found no shadcn, registry, MCP SDK or Hono references. npm run test:policy-fault passed its one baseline test with 139 skipped, detected the single planted fault and restored the read policy. npm run test:privilege-fault passed 26 tests across two files in both baseline and restored states and detected all 22 planted faults. The complete requested chain exited 0.

Ran node scripts/sign-in-review.mjs --digest after the checks. Confirmed the working tree was unchanged before writing this record. Docker cleanup completed, and a final inventory found zero containers, images, volumes or networks carrying this run label.
limits: npm run test:image could not run in the sandbox because Buildx activity-file access and keychain credential lookup are restricted. The coordinator runs the image test outside the sandbox before anything is pushed. No image-test result from this review is included as evidence.
The initial npm ci could not run with the default cache because the sandbox denied access to its temporary files. Retrying with an isolated writable cache passed. No cache permissions were changed.

Checks ran locally on macOS with Node.js 22.23.2 and npm 10.9.8. The isolated prune check establishes the local installed dependency tree, not the Linux runtime image. The coordinator image test remains necessary.

No real company directory registration, external SMTP delivery, production storage permissions or complete production browser sign-in were exercised. In-process sign-in tests do not establish complete production HTTP behaviour.
Response padding is not a constant-time guarantee under load. Deferred email delivery is not a durable queue. Multiple replicas need shared rate limiting or an ingress limit.
The digest verifies content correspondence, not reviewer identity or independence. Pull request review remains necessary.
